disposition_records.T07-BENCHMARKING-NONMACOS-BUILD: The public VectorCoreBenchmarking product failed on iOS/tvOS/watchOS/visionOS simulators (unguarded Host/Process in EnvCapture; pre-existing on main). It is now guarded with honest off-macOS fallbacks and an OS-family marker; macOS metadata is cmp-identical.
disposition_records.T07-NORMALIZATIONCORE-CATALYST-FLOAT16: N01 (84f42d0) used Float16 unguarded in NormalizationCore, breaking the VectorCore scheme on Mac Catalyst and generic macOS (x86_64 slice). It is guarded with the MixedPrecisionKernels:4086 condition; arm64 path unchanged and discriminated by NormalizationRangeContractTests.halfWideningAndScalarMagnitude. Test-side instances: T09.
disposition_records.T07-CI-PRODUCT-PLATFORM-COVERAGE: CI built only the VectorCore scheme cross-platform. A fail-closed loop now builds every Package.swift library product on every destination; test_platform_ci_coverage.py enforces it (validate_github.rb unedited).

validation.policy: unittest 264 OK in-repo and out-of-repo on the merged integration tree; validate_github.rb passes

limitations: Policy N1: line-based; a deliberate `set +e`, reassignment of $products, or a `shell:` override is not modelled (accidental regressions are closed).
Parser N2: products not spelled `.library(` (helper calls) are omitted; interpolated names are accepted as literals.
Off-macOS fallbacks are compile-verified only; no simulator runtime.
incident: The implementer ran `git stash`/`stash pop` once in its worktree; root verified the shared stash list is empty and all worktrees are intact. Rule restated: never git stash.
